title: Understanding the Intercept Term
text: Consider what the intercept term represents in a linear regression model. It is the expected value of the response variable when all predictors are zero. Think about how centering the data might affect this term.

title: Effect of Centering on Coefficients
text: When you center the data, each predictor variable has a mean of zero. How might this affect the calculation of the coefficients in the regression model? Consider the role of the intercept in this context.
